content: The title of Section 6 in the American Diabetes Association (ADA) Standards of Care has been revised to Glycemic Goals and Hypoglycemia. All content related to hypoglycemia throughout the document has been consolidated into this section. 1. The section has been updated to emphasize the need for more frequent glycemic assessments in populations requiring closer monitoring. 2. Recommendations for the use of continuous glucose monitoring (CGM) and specific glycemic targets have been incorporated into the updates. Sections addressing glucose-lowering treatments and their effects on microvascular and cardiovascular outcomes have been revised to reflect findings from long-term studies that demonstrate the benefits of newer diabetes medications. 8b. A new subsection has been added to provide guidance on scenarios where deintensification of diabetes medications may be appropriate. 11c. Another new subsection has been introduced to assist healthcare providers in reviewing a patient’s history of hypoglycemia, their awareness of hypoglycemia, and their associated risk factors.
